notes.title: CreatorCrate PREPARING FOR LAUNCH Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
We're almost ready for the Steam launch on August 11! Here's the Companion Human Update to celebrate.

Companion Human Game Mode
To celebrate the Steam launch, I've added the Companion Human Challenge. This game mode is the TOTALLY CANON CreatorCrate / Human fan fiction where you must follow the 3 laws: 
* Protect Companion
* No Abandon
* No Devour (unless very hungry)
[previewyoutube=EE3Q0DYDVEI;full][/previewyoutube]

Demo Converter
If you've played the CreatorCrate Demo, progress up to the first boss fight will be converted when you play the full game. Progress from the Zero G preview and a few items are not converted since these are shown out of order to give Demo players a taste of what's to come.

This update also adds Steam Cloud saves, and a bunch of other improvements.

Update 1.1.1

 Added Companion Human Challenge!
 Added Steam cloud saves
 Added a tutorial room for learning how to hurt your enemies with chairs
 Made challenge descriptions more entertaining
 Made Clacker trigger explosions when falling in Action Movie Challenge
 Made more explosions during Vatmeat Chamber fight in Action Movie Challenge
 Checkpoints activated by winning a boss fight give you a message to let you know what's happening now
 Decompression happens slower so that you can really savor the horror of getting sucked out a broken window into the merciless void of space.
 Added "fEEd mE" messages to Hongry challenge.
 Made tutorial gun turret destructible
 Added more tutorial decorations
 Prevented tutorial gun turret from firing after you've passed it to avoid a tutorial soft lock
 Improved the demo save game converter to better communicate what it does.
 Changed save game compatibility to allow for more flexibility in old versions of the game running saves from future versions of the game.
 Forced the game to be single instance
 Fixed an issue where the death screen on permadeath briefly showed the game menu

notes.title: Steam Playtest Update
notes.content:
We're blown away by the amount of interest in the Steam Playtest for CreatorCrate. After 1 day, we have close to 200 playtesters! 

We're closing open Playtest applications for now to give us a chance to slow down and talk with the current playtesters. However, there may be another round of open applications in the future.

If you're already a playtester, we'd love to hear from you.

Stop by our Discord Community to talk about your experiences playing the game and hang out with the developers! We're an LGBTQ+ friendly space where everyone is welcome.

Other ways to get in touch

 Twitter (DMs are open)
 Bug reports
 Email: creatorcrategames@gmail.com


Also, if you missed the signup but would love a chance to playtest and be a part of the community, please get in touch because we might be able to let you in individually.

Thank you again to everyone who signed up. It really means the world to us to see this much interest in the game.

Playtesters have free access to the game's Beta from now until release.

notes.title: Difficulty Setting! CreatorCrate Update 0.19.0
notes.content:
New update with a difficulty setting and the ability to hide in smoke from humans. 

The game still comes with an intended difficulty that is balanced to be a fast and challenging experience, while still being fair. However, we decided to add the setting because we recognize that the intended level of challenge can be a barrier to enjoying the game for some players, while other players crave even more challenge. Have fun!

 Finished changes needed to release a playable demo January 22nd
 Massive improvements to the wire/electricity system
 The broom is now the ultimate weapon.
 Made acid much more reliable
 Replaced deep destructible block and rubber textures with more finished textures.
 Fixed bug where clackers were being worn as hats, which was against regulations.
 Bigger debris
 Fine tuned some particle effects to make them juicier
 Fixed bug where danger sparks appeared over an electric source where no danger existed.
 Fixed bug in the tutorial that could allow a door to prevent you from finishing the tutorial
 Fixed bug that prevented decelerator from saving in the right state
 Fixed bug where you could grab a scientist through the floor.

notes.title: Update 0.3.0 See curvature in map transitions!
notes.content:
Update 0.3.0

 Put in a new map transition that better shows the curvature of the station.
 Added more maps to early areas.
 Fixed issue where you can't stand on an item on a weight switch.
 Fixed an issue where the player oscillates between falling and standing when on a stack of items.
 Fixed issue with enemies spawning where you can see them
 Improved npc aiming at long distances.
 Fixed issue with not gates not initializing properly
 Fixed bug that stuck smoke detectors in the on position and prevented the fire symbol from showing.
 Added more glowy effects.
 Fixed bug where sometimes the ammo in blueprint meters didn't clear on loading a game.
 Made exploding canisters standable.

notes.title: Update 0.2.0 Alpha
notes.content:
Update 0.2.0

 Added a Resolution and Quality menu
 Minor changes to tutorial.
 Fixed issue with pinger animations.
 Missile turret colliders tweaked.
 Enemy dialog made more clear.
 fixed issue with player clipping into ship airlock key reader.
 Fixed issue with audio sources playing briefly when volume is set to 0
 Solved issue with menu direction input not getting rebound.
 Fixed issue with potential healing indicator getting stuck.

notes.title: Update 0.1.3 Alpha
notes.content:
Update 0.1.3

 Eliminated the trash dump from the starting area because the trash dump was doing the same thing as Builder Boxes in providing a way to get lost special items, and the trash dump was confusing new players too much.
 Dialog borders have random colors.
 Dialog boxes show zoomed in views of the faces of speaking NPCs.
 Big parts of the tutorial have been overhauled.
 Added a small intro sequence (in addition to the intro video)
 Fixed a bug where acid melting through large sections of blocks caused serious lag.  This sometimes caused stutters in the section to the right of the starting area even when no acid was visible.
  Eliminated some maps that were causing issues.

notes.title: Update 0.1.2 Alpha
notes.content:
Fixed an issue with camera motion not being smooth enough.
 Other tweaks to camera movement
 Added better acid particles and effects.
 Fixed an issue where acid clips through the floor in some situations.
 Fixed a bug where the player can enter a trap box from above.
 Added more maps.
 Fixed issue with sometimes having picked up objects rotate freely in the player's hand.
 Throw and swing max velocities have been lowered (this shouldn't interfere with terrorizing humans with heavy vending machines).

notes.title: Alpha 0.1.1
notes.content:
Fixed minor issues with camera jitter
 Made small changes to how camera handles
 Prevented the player arm from shaking in some situations
 Made the exit of the first boss fight less prone to the player getting stuck.
 Fixed some issues related to volume in decompressed areas 
 Fixed a bug where detection of holding jump depends on frame rate.

notes.title: Alpha 0.1.0
notes.content:
Many bug fixes, including smoother camera controller, and many issues related to the map and decelerator transitions.

Fixed a major bug that prevented freefall turning on higher end computers.

Moved to version 0.1.0.  From now on, the middle value of the version number will be increased with regular updates, and the final digit will denote small bug fixes.

notes.title: Update 0.0.5 Alpha
notes.content:
Big changes to how the player handles in freefall.
 Many small changes to how the player handles in gravity sections.
 A lot of maps have been added to the procedural level generator
 Added many new music tracks.
 Fixes and changes to how songs are selected.
 Press F6 to give feedback directly from the game.
 The entrance to the central hub generates more cleanly.
 Game has an intro sequence.
 Small changes to the tutorial section.
 Acid dissolves walls in a circle instead of wandering in a random line.    
 Fixed a bug where the Bunsen burner wasn’t setting off smoke alarms
 Many more small tweaks and bug fixes.

notes.title: Update 0.0.4
notes.content:
Fixed bug where player could double jump by dropping a ragdolled body in mid air.
 Minor changes to menus
 Fixed issue with player getting stuck in airlock doors.
 Fixed issue with player getting stuck under rail door(stay out of there!).
 Wrong clones make terrifying noises now, you monsters!
 Humans make cute noises. . . you monsters.
 BuilderBoxes are in the game.  They make tools that you’ve found, to prevent players from getting into situations where they don’t have access to tools in areas that heavily use those tools.
 Fixed an issue with decompression causing a large frame drop in areas with fire traps.

notes.title: Update 0.0.3 Alpha
notes.content:
Update 0.0.3

 Increased player stopping power more
 Added Outside Station maps
 Fixed bugs and added more polish to input systems.
 More tweaks to the feel of player movement.
 More tweaks to throwing and humans getting knocked out.
 Player sounds now play in vacuum, but they are pitch shifted down.
 There’s a massive death laser somewhere on the station.  Try to guess where!
 Fixed bug where npcs sometimes don’t drop their weapons when they ragdoll.
 Fixed a bug where the targeter doesn’t show up for things that you can swing on if they are far away.
 Fixed some bugs in level generation where walls appeared where they shouldn’t.
 Fixed a level generation issue where an area is sometimes not accessible.
 Made it easier to tell when you have a partial bar of matter.
 Knife trail is turned off when swinging from the ceiling.
 Added a permanent death mode.
 Added more background details.
 Fixed issue where npcs draw weapons when ragdolled and on fire (i.e. most of the time).
 The camera now rotates a bit to point in the direction of movement.
 Added a better tutorial.
 inaccessible areas surrounded by indestructible blocks have a more subtle texture.
 Fixed issues with menu elements anchoring wrong

notes.title: Update 0.0.2 Pre-Alpha
notes.content:
Big improvements to human animations (more animation changes to come)
 Made objects higher friction for easier stacking
 Gave the player better stopping power
 Camera zooming is no longer based on cursor placement.  It is now automated so that players don’t have to manage zoom level.
 You always pick up the weapons of armed humans instead of picking them up.
 Alerted unarmed humans can be picked up again.
 Airlock controls are covered when not usable.
 Level generation screen has changed text for loading, reshuffling, and generating
 Levels generate with fewer dead ends.
 Structure of level generation has changed for better flow from area to area
 Lamps turn on in explored rooms and are off in unexplored rooms.
 There are map markers for switch door pairs in the robotics section. The map markers respond to the switch being thrown.  A line is drawn between them on highlight to show that they are connected.  There is a sequence which shows when a door is unlocked.
 Added more UI sounds
 Player movement has been changed to make it snappier
 Map shows areas that are known about but unexplored differently from how it shows explored areas.
 more enemies spawn
 Repair now heals for 1 heart instead of half a heart.
 Added effects to help players know when they’re low on health
 Made throwing objects easier
 Furniture is sturdier
 Fixed issues with items clipping through the walls.
 There is a slider to change screen shake in the menu
 Controller support and a key configuration menu have been added.

notes.title: Update 0.0.1 Pre-Alpha
notes.content:
Changes:


 Player can no longer knock npcs down simply by running into them.  You must throw objects,  swing objects like clubs, or use a quick drop in order to knock out NPCs
 Alerted NPCs cannot be picked up
 Fast moving objects make a trail and sound effect
 NPCs become alerted if the player bumps into their backs
 Throwing is totally based on arm motion now.
 Put in a more readable health meter.
 The tutorial has been expanded.
 New maps and hazards.
 Fixed a bug where items in the held item display sometimes didn’t render.
 Implemented version numbers for updates and save files.
 Fixed bug with acid traps having a hit box that is too large.
 Acid launchers launch more slowly.
 Acid does less damage to the player.
 Major overhaul of elevators and elevator buttons.
 UI element highlights what the player’s arm is targeting
 The player doesn't stick to walls when holding a running fan in freefall.
 Acid vials now don’t break when the player walks into them.
